passages.title: The Green Leaf
passages.text: A. The Green Leaf: This café is perfect for those who love organic, plant-based food. We offer a wide range of salads, soups, and hearty grain bowls. Everything is locally sourced and prepared fresh every morning. Ideal for a light lunch.

passages.title: Pasta Palace
passages.text: B. Pasta Palace: If you are looking for a quick and affordable meal, our pasta bar is the place to be. Choose your favorite sauce and pasta shape, and we will cook it right in front of you in minutes. Great for families on a budget.

passages.title: The Golden Grill
passages.text: C. The Golden Grill: We specialize in high-quality steaks and grilled vegetables. Our restaurant has a formal atmosphere, making it a great choice for business meetings or celebrating special occasions. Reservations are highly recommended.

passages.title: Ocean Breeze
passages.text: D. Ocean Breeze: Located right on the beach, this restaurant offers the freshest seafood in town. Enjoy your meal on our outdoor terrace while listening to the waves. We are open for dinner only, from 6 PM to 11 PM.

passages.title: Coffee Corner
passages.text: E. Coffee Corner: Need a place to study or work? We provide free high-speed Wi-Fi and plenty of power outlets. Enjoy our selection of artisan coffees and homemade cakes while you get your work done in a quiet environment.

passages.title: Spice Route
passages.text: F. Spice Route: Experience authentic flavors from across Asia. Our menu features spicy curries, stir-fries, and dumplings. We offer a delivery service if you prefer to eat in the comfort of your own home.

passages.title: The Midnight Diner
passages.text: G. The Midnight Diner: We are the only place in the city that stays open 24 hours a day. Whether you want breakfast at midnight or a burger at dawn, our kitchen is always ready to serve you.

passages.title: Sweet Treats
passages.text: H. Sweet Treats: A paradise for dessert lovers. We serve a variety of international pastries, ice creams, and hot chocolates. It is the perfect spot to meet friends for a relaxing afternoon tea.

questions.question: Sarah needs a quiet place to finish her university project and wants to be able to use the internet.
questions.explanation: Sarah needs Wi-Fi and a quiet environment, which Coffee Corner provides.

questions.question: Mark wants to take his business partner out for a high-end meal to discuss a new contract.
questions.explanation: The Golden Grill is described as having a formal atmosphere suitable for business meetings.

questions.question: Elena is a vegetarian who prefers to eat food that hasn't traveled far to reach the restaurant.
questions.explanation: The Green Leaf focuses on plant-based food and locally sourced ingredients.

questions.question: David finishes his night shift at 3 AM and is looking for a place to get a hot meal.
questions.explanation: The Midnight Diner is the only place open 24 hours, perfect for someone eating at 3 AM.

questions.question: Chloe wants to order some spicy food to eat while watching a movie at home.
questions.explanation: Spice Route offers spicy food and has a delivery service for eating at home.
